info.title: LMS Career Service
info.description: A student's verified skill profile and AI-assisted resume builder: platform-verified certificates, courses and assessment scores next to self-declared entries (labelled), ATS-safe templates, versions, rule-based ATS score and keyword gap, AI suggestions checked against the student's own facts, PDF, JSON Resume and public share links.

get.description: Personal details from user-management (verified), my own entries (self-declared) and the items the platform added — certificates, completed courses, assessment scores (verified, read-only). A revoked certificate stays listed with `active: false` and the reason, but never reaches a resume.

get.description: `draft` is what you edit (send its `draft_revision` back as `expected_revision`). `document` is what a reader sees: verified entries are marked `verified: true`, entries deleted from the profile or revoked are gone.

patch.description: Send the `draft_revision` you loaded as `expected_revision`: if the resume changed since (another tab), `409 STALE_DRAFT`. Sections are reordered by the order of `draft.sections`; items by the order of each section's `items`. A section may only hold items of its own kind, and only your own entries can carry their own `bullets`.

get.description: Server-rendered with the resume's template, from the current draft or from a saved `version_no`. `template_key` renders it with another template instead, to preview that template with the student's own data (nothing is saved); `inline=true` asks the browser to show it rather than download it. The PDF uses standard fonts: characters outside Latin-1 (for example Devanagari) print as `?`, and `X-Unrenderable-Characters` says how many.
